description:
General (meta) information elements. Information about modelelement.
Used for all models

Derivation.description:
Links one element of the model to another in semantic terms. The source provides information for a more complete understanding of the meaning or purpose of the target.

This is model information. It concerns information for understanding elements, not data values carried by the elements . (See the entity Transformation for more information).

Since derivation is part of the meta model, it is possible between all model elements. Therefore, the relationships are defined here as generic foreign keys.

derivationtype.description: Kind of information the source provides for the target

sourceelement.description: ID of any kind of source element

targetelement.description: ID of any kind of target element

additionalProps.description: additional properties (aka user defined properties udp) are  any properties of an this element  added by the current modeller. They serve as an extension to the predfefined element properties.

Mapping.description:
Mappings are links that connect reference value ranges with each other. They are typically used to connect different value ranges from different systems and ensure that values are transferred from one system to another.
The assignment of reference values from the source value list must be clearly translatable into values from the target value list. Many reference values leading to the same target value (many-to-1) are possible.

valuemappings.description: Value assignments are links between reference values of the two reference value ranges.
